purpose: Prepare the remaining P009 privacy lifecycle implementation using existing Phone seams while approved carrier/media/privacy facts remain unanswered. This is a preparation artifact, not implementation acceptance.

governingScope.text: Durable voicemail/transcript, consent-sensitive recording, retention/export/deletion, read-state/notification semantics, interrupted/replayed events and actual history/summary after restart.

reuse.use: Keep retention and lifecycle operations tenant-scoped. Reuse exportCallContent and deleteCallContent; do not introduce a second content store or deletion ledger.
Resolve ingest ownership from stored call identity. Keep first-arrival/read-state replay semantics and compute summary from stored call/voicemail outcomes.

reuse.surface: Existing deletion tombstone and replay refusal
reuse.use: Use the existing atomic erasure/tombstone operation after policy eligibility. Retain fail-closed active-call, recording-reference and mirrored-content guards.
Retain durable transcript flush before voicemail write and explicit acknowledged success. A recording reference is not a capture engine or consent approval.

confirmedSourceBehavior.claim: Memory and Postgres voicemail replay preserve first arrival and owner readAt; a second read transition returns false.
confirmedSourceBehavior.limit: Static source inspection in this preparation pass; historical execution remains separate.

confirmedSourceBehavior.claim: Summary unreadVoicemail derives from stored voicemail readAt, rather than an independently persisted counter.
confirmedSourceBehavior.limit: Does not establish a notification delivery policy.

confirmedSourceBehavior.claim: Worker shutdown flushes transcript before deriving the text voicemail and does not infer an audio duration from response latency.
confirmedSourceBehavior.limit: A comment about absent Egress is not live proof of approved capture or transcription consent.

existingRecurringGuards.observes: First arrival/readAt survive replay; copy isolation; exactly one read transition.
Memory and disposable real Postgres concurrent replay, tenant isolation, fresh database connections.
Acknowledged content/read-state/summary survive real sidecar SIGKILL and database restart; foreign tenant remains empty.

pendingPolicyInputs.required: Approved policy reference and jurisdiction-specific consent requirements for recording and transcription, including revocation and interrupted-call behavior.
Approved retention durations, eligibility clock, exclusions/holds and scope covering Phone content, retained media and conversation mirrors.
Approved notification recipients, destinations/channels, content minimization, consent/opt-out and replay/delivery policy.
Explicit approved enablement for consent-sensitive audio storage. Default absence of approval must not be treated as approval.

checks: No approved policy or missing required consent refuses the storage/transcription action before its write.
An approved synthetic policy fixture and consent positive control permit exactly the intended action.
Revocation or expired authority refuses replay and late callbacks.
readyVerificationWork.laneBoundary: Coordinate actual policy/auth contract with the live P010 source lane; do not duplicate its authority model.

checks: A policy-defined cutoff removes only eligible tenant content using the existing tombstone transaction.
An active call, retained recording or mirror without coordinated deletion remains blocked with its reason.
Crash/replay/rollback preserve atomicity, and later callbacks cannot resurrect erased content.
Unexpired and held positive controls remain retrievable.
Only the stored tenant and approved audience receive the permitted payload.
Replay and restart do not duplicate an approved notification.
Read-state and delivery-state remain distinct; reading a voicemail does not prove external notification delivery.
No notification send is enabled before the policy and channel are approved.

verification.retainedProof: Read prior WI10004987 terminal defect proofs and existing ledgers by reference; no old test matrix replayed merely to reconstruct history.
limits: No chosen retention period, invented consent rule or notification audience.
No raw audio capture, media/mirror erasure or external send implemented by this preparation artifact.
No R42/R43/R46/R47, P009 or public PSTN completion claim.
